leakage_signals: Unstated tolerance for tight or multiple connections
Unstated preference for earlier arrival versus connection reliability
verdict.rationale: No option clearly dominates on the stated facts. A arrives earliest and has one stop but has a relatively tight 55-minute connection. B is cheapest and still arrives early enough for a Tuesday-morning event, but adds a second connection. C provides a longer one-stop connection that may be preferable for reliability, at a higher fare and with only aisle seats. D is cheaper than A and has the most connection buffer, but arrives substantially later. Selecting among these tradeoffs requires unstated priorities.
